paper_title: Search for Axion Dark Matter from 1.1 to 1.3 GHz with ADMX
notes: ADMX haloscope search for axion dark matter over 1.10-1.31 GHz (4.54-5.41 ueV), reaching better-than-KSVZ sensitivity on g_agamma at 90% C.L. with assumed local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3. No numerical limit table is provided in the text; the actual exclusion curve is only shown in Fig. 3. The emitted data points are approximate KSVZ-line coupling values (g_agamma = alpha*g_gamma/(pi*f_a), |g_gamma|=0.97) computed at the frequency-range endpoints, representing the ~KSVZ sensitivity level the run achieved.
